name: aegis-monorepo
description: Aegis onboarding platform with backend and frontend services

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix aegis run dev"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix aegis run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix aegis install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix aegis run build
